question: The IMNCI strategy is built on three interlocking components: improving case management skills of health workers, improving the overall health system, and improving family and community health practices.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The IMNCI strategy explicitly operates at three levels — health worker skills, health system strengthening, and family/community practices. All three are required for effective impact on child survival.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. These are the three official IMNCI components: (1) improved case-management skills at first-level health facilities, (2) strengthened health system support (drug supply, referral, supervision), and (3) improved family and community practices (care-seeking, home care, nutrition).
